subject_description: a chibi rogue girl with a long white ponytail, a black hooded cape and a violet dagger in each hand
initial_pose: standing ready, knees slightly bent, daggers held low
description: fast light run cycle to the right, quick strides, body leaning forward, both daggers held low and swept back, the long white ponytail and black cape streaming behind her. She stays in the same place on the canvas (running in place, the background scrolls), a seamless loop. Side view facing right in every frame, same size. No dust, no effects.
